item.title: FAA Ground Stop Chaos, Van Hollen Challenges Schumer, SpaceX Makes History: AM Update 11/16 (Ad-Free)
item.description:
A nationwide FAA ground stop triggers thousands of flight cancellations, exposing vulnerabilities in the nation's aging air traffic control system and renewing calls for modernization. Democrat Senator Chris Van Hollen challenges Senator Chuck Schumer for Senate Majority Leader, arguing that Democrats need new leadership following their sweeping midterm victories. SpaceX makes history by successfully catching its Starship spacecraft returning from orbit for the first time, marking a major breakthrough in reusable rocket technology. All 191 people aboard a Mississippi River cruise ship survive after a tanker collides with the vessel in New Orleans, causing it to capsize and triggering a massive rescue operation.
